text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Symboli Rudolf helps the students ease into the new year, she receives the news that Air Groove has collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reason turns out to be from overwork, and Rudolf blames herself for letting Air Groove's schedule get so out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove snaps back, saying that Rudolf doesn't understand at all—words that seem to strike home.
